name: Costco Food Court (Logan & Draper, UT) 1/4-Lb All-Beef Hot Dog on Steamed Bun
whyItWorks: The legendary $1.50 combo! Steamed all-beef frank on an ultra-soft bun. Completely seed-free, zero roughage, and highly filling during errands.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hot Dog plain or with mild yellow mustard; avoid the raw onion crank dispenser and relish.
watchOuts: Skip raw onions, relish, and sauerkraut
